symptoms: Active anterior or posterior nasal bleeding

management_steps.details: Direct nasal pressure for 10-15 minutes. Apply Bactroban ointment. Nasal packing with Merocel OR Cyclokapron (Tranexamic Acid) 500mg/5ml soaked gauze.
Insert Foley catheter (10-14F), inflate bulb with 10-20ml water, pull anteriorly. Cyclokapron (Tranexamic Acid) 15 mg/kg (max 1g) IV over 15 min. Augmentin oral x 3 days.
